description: Submit movie work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery. Creative baseline: unless the user declined, build at least one dopamine hook from dopamine_hooks_get into this prompt, script or sound.

asset.description: Audio-only source: Voice, Music, SFX result or an uploaded audio file. Video/Movie assets belong in clips; use clips.volume for their sound or privately upload extracted audio. Uploaded media kind is checked at dispatch.

clip_index.description: Optional scene anchor. offset is relative to this scene start; resolved after measured narration changes scene lengths. Omit for absolute movie seconds.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

cues.description: Verified/imported source timestamps; never infer speech alignment from text length.
cues.title: Cues

duration.description: Length on the movie timeline; no speed change. Non-looping layers cannot exceed source_duration.
duration.title: Duration

preserve_source.description: Protect a complete narration source: trim=0, no loop/fade/envelope/mute, full measured file duration. Timeline Blender programs must preserve this audio and resolved visual boundaries.
preserve_source.title: Preserve Source

source_duration.description: Length of the selected source region, not the entire file. Loop repeats only this region.
source_duration.title: Source Duration

asset.description: Audio-only source: Voice, Music, SFX result or an uploaded audio file. Video/Movie assets belong in clips; use clips.volume for their sound or privately upload extracted audio. Uploaded media kind is checked at dispatch.

mode.description: scene builds a new 3D/VSE/compositor scene; timeline edits the prepared Movie VSE project including its timed audio and text.
mode.title: Mode

python.description: Blender 5.2.1 bpy Python. Runs in an isolated CPU container, never the web/worker process. Build or edit bpy.context.scene; server renders it. HIRU contains resolved timeline, assets and output dimensions. No network, credentials, external packages or GPU.
python.title: Python

reference_kind.description: Representation rendered by this script. Non-RGB control maps require a matching verified LTX IC-LoRA path.
reference_kind.title: Reference Kind

required_transform_clips.description: With timeline_layout=clips, clip indices whose scale/offset/rotation must change during their own frame interval. A missing, muted, or static target fails before rendering; use for promised photo zoom/pan. This is transform validation, not proof of arbitrary visual effects.
required_transform_clips.title: Required Transform Clips

summary.description: Human-readable creative intent, including camera, animation, compositing and audio changes. Shown in Movie history.
summary.title: Summary

timeline_layout.description: joined preserves the legacy single MOVIE strip. clips exposes each original photo as IMAGE and each prepared video as MOVIE, named clip-0, clip-1, etc. Use clips for per-photo zoom/pan; audio and captions stay separate.
timeline_layout.title: Timeline Layout

hold_last_frame.description: Allow extending a video by holding its final frame and padding audio with silence.
hold_last_frame.title: Hold Last Frame

end.description: Seconds in the original audio, exclusive.
end.title: End

start.description: Seconds in the original audio, inclusive.
start.title: Start

time.description: Seconds relative to the layer start.
time.title: Time

clip_index.description: When supplied, start/end are relative to this scene; resolved after narration timing.
clip_index.title: Clip Index

follow_clip.description: With clip_index, extend the title until the actual end of that scene.
follow_clip.title: Follow Clip

size.description: Font size as fraction of output height.
size.title: Size

x.description: Normalized horizontal center, left to right.
x.title: X

y.description: Normalized vertical center, top to bottom.
y.title: Y

asset.description: Optional per-scene narration. Overrides sync_plan.asset; sentence IDs belong to this source. Bind each scene clone output asset here.

sentence_ids.description: Stable source transcript IDs s0, s1, ...; one sentence per line is recommended.
sentence_ids.title: Sentence Ids

asset.description: Default narration for segments without their own asset. May be omitted when every segment has an asset.

duration_policy.description: expand chooses the next allowed duration that fits actual speech, up to 120 seconds. fixed stops if speech exceeds the selected duration.
duration_policy.title: Duration Policy

end_guard.description: continuous and scene_sources: mandatory silence after the actual complete file end of the final narrated scene; never shrunk. ASR sentence end is NOT an audio trim boundary.
end_guard.title: End Guard

mode.description: Audio policy. continuous: play ONE complete source once, preserve original pauses, cut visuals at measured sentence starts; requires all sentence IDs in order. scene_sources: each segment plays ITS OWN complete source file (scene Voice clone) once from sample 0 to the measured file end, never trimmed to ASR cue ends; requires all of that source's sentence IDs. segments: legacy SELECTED-REGION edit that trims each scene to ASR sentence spans with 20ms fades; it does not promise full-source coverage. Omitted mode means segments for backward compatibility; new plans should always state the mode.
mode.title: Mode

padding_policy.description: preserve keeps requested lead/tail. With fixed duration, shrink may proportionally reduce only lead/tail to fit; speech is never cut or sped up. For exact 15s shorts use fixed + shrink. If speech alone exceeds the budget, shorten the script or select fewer sentences.
padding_policy.title: Padding Policy

start_padding.description: continuous only: silence before the whole source, after any unbound intro clips.
start_padding.title: Start Padding

acknowledge_privacy.description: Confirm the user has permission to process any personal data in the inputs.
acknowledge_privacy.title: Acknowledge Privacy

acknowledge_rights.description: Confirm the user has the rights or permissions to use the source material.
acknowledge_rights.title: Acknowledge Rights

aspect.description: Aspect ratio category for the movie output.
aspect.title: Aspect

audio_layers.description: Optional audio tracks for voice, music and sound effects, with timing and gain.
audio_layers.title: Audio Layers

blender_program.description: Optional Blender scene or timeline edit with its assets and output settings.

clips.description: Ordered visual clips with their durations, sources and optional trims.
clips.title: Clips

graphics.description: Timed on-screen elements such as titles and captions.
graphics.title: Graphics

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

music.description: Optional background music track with placement on the movie timeline.

sync_plan.description: Submit before Voice finishes. Bind a future voice asset; the server reads its output timing and resolves sentence/scene placement automatically after completion.

title.description: Display title for the plan or movie.
title.title: Title

voice.description: Optional narration track with placement on the movie timeline.
